failures_so_far.message:
Expected: String containing "Strength +2, Agility -1"
  But was:  "You see a dagger.
This equipment is sound. A short blade with a close-fitting grip. The point has been kept sharp.
Damage: 1d4 per penetration.
Hit bonus: +0; Penetration bonus: +1.
Penetration uses Strength modifier (cap 3).
Attributes: Piercing.
On damaging hits, independent attempts (targets may resist):
  10%: Confused - staggers unpredictably for 2 turns.
Equip slots: Hand.
Equip bonuses (if the stat exists): Agility -1, Strength +2."
